mapper.select: SELECT /*SQL-ID : isry.couns.constt.etcntabrd.mapper.BbsRplyListMapper : 댓글상담실*/ count(*) FROM AYE100 WHERE 1=1 AND BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '08' /*게시글유형구분코드*/ AND DEL_YN = 'N' /*삭제여부*/

/* * SQL-ID : isry.couns.constt.etcntabrd.mapper.BbsRplyListMapper : 댓글상담실(조회) * 2023.06.01 수정 - Jeong.Won.Je */ SELECT AA.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO AS BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO /*게시글번호*/ , AA.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD AS BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD /*게시글구분코드*/ , AA.BBSCTT_TTL_NM AS BBSCTT_TTL_NM /*게시글제목명*/ , C##RG.DEC_B64(AA.WRTR_NM_ENCPT) AS WRTR_NM_ENCPT /*작성자*/ , AA.BBSCTT_CN AS BBSCTT_CN /*게시글내용*/ , AA.CNTN_IP_ADDR AS CNTN_IP_ADDR /*아이피주소*/ , AA.EML_ADDR_ENCPT AS EML_ADDR_ENCPT /*이메일주소*/ , to_char(AA.FRST_REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS FRST_REG_DT /*최초등록일자*/ , AA.RDCNT_NOCS AS RDCNT_NOCS /*조회수*/ , AA.ATFINO AS ATFINO /*첨부파일번호*/ , (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM AYE110 Z WHERE Z.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = AA.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO AND Z.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = AA.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD AND Z.DEL_YN = 'N') AS CMNT , COUNT(*) OVER() AS TOTAL_COUNT , AA.DEL_YN AS DEL_YN , ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SCA100 T1 , SAA200 T2 WHERE T1.ENFSN_NO = T2.ENFSN_NO AND T2.USER_ID = AA.LAST_MDFR_ID ) AS MDFR_CNT FROM AYE100 AS AA WHERE 1=1 AND AA.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '08' AND ( AA.DEL_YN != 'Y' OR AA.DEL_YN IS NULL )
AND AA.BBSCTT_TTL_NM LIKE '%'||#{BBSCTT_TTL_NM}||'%'
AND AA.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO LIKE '%'||#{BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO}||'%'
AND CASE WHEN LENGTH(AA.WRTR_NM_ENCPT) < 24 THEN AA.WRTR_NM_ENCPT ELSE C##RG.DEC_B64(AA.WRTR_NM_ENCPT) END LIKE '%' || #{WRTR_NM_ENCPT} || '%'
ORDER BY AA.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO DESC OFFSET #{START_IDX} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{ROW_COUNT} ROWS ONLY

/* * SQL-ID : isry.couns.constt.etcntabrd.mapper.BbsRplyListMapper.selectInqBbsRplyListDetail : 댓글상담실(상세) * 2023.04.27 수정 : 불필요한 컬럼 삭제 - Jeong.Won.Je */ SELECT AA.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO AS BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO /* 게시글번호 */ , AA.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD AS BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD /* 게시글구분코드 */ , AA.BBSCTT_TTL_NM AS BBSCTT_TTL_NM /* 게시글제목명 */ , TO_CHAR(AA.FRST_REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD AM HH12:MI:SS') AS WRT_DT /* 작성일자 */ , C##RG.DEC_B64(AA.WRTR_NM_ENCPT) AS WRTR_NM_ENCPT /* 작성자명 */ , AA.HPGE_URL_ADDR AS HPGE_URL_ADDR /* 홈페이지URL */ , AA.BRTH_YMD AS BRTH_YR /* 출생년도 */ , AA.FRST_RGTR_ID AS CLIENA_ID /* 작성자아이디 */ , AA.EML_ADDR_ENCPT AS EML_ADDR_ENCPT /* 이메일주소 */ , AA.RDCNT_NOCS AS RDCNT_NOCS /* 조회수 */ , AA.CNTN_IP_ADDR AS CNTN_IP_ADDR /* 아이피주소 */ , AA.BBSCTT_CN AS BBSCTT_CN /* 게시글내용 */ , AA.SXDC_SE_CD AS SXDC_SE_CD /* 성별 */ , AA.ACBG_SE_CD AS ACBG_SE_CD /* 학력구분코드 */ , AA.GRADE_SE_CD AS GRADE_SE_CD /* 학년구분코드 */ , AA.GRDTN_STTS_SE_CD AS GRDTN_STTS_SE_CD /* 졸업상태구분코드 */ , AA.REAL_CONSTT_SE_CD AS REAL_CONSTT_SE_CD /* 실제상담자구분코드 */ , AA.REAL_CONSTT_ETC_CN AS REAL_CONSTT_ETC_CN /* 실제상담자기타내용 */ , AA.YNGBGS_SE_NO AS YNGBGS_SE_NO /* 청소년구분번호 */ , AA.PROBM_STTS_LCLAS_SE_CD AS PROBM_STTS_LCLAS_SE_CD /* 문제상태대분류구분코드 */ , AA.PROBM_STTS_MLSFC_SE_CD AS PROBM_STTS_MLSFC_SE_CD /* 문제상태중분류구분코드 */ , AA.PROBM_STTS_SCLAS_SE_CD AS PROBM_STTS_SCLAS_SE_CD /* 문제상태소분류구분코드 */ , AA.PROBM_CAS_LCLAS_SE_CD AS PROBM_CAS_LCLAS_SE_CD /* 문제원인대분류구분코드 */ , AA.PROBM_CAS_SCLAS_SE_CD AS PROBM_CAS_SCLAS_SE_CD /* 문제원인소분류구분코드 */ , AA.ETC_CN AS ETC_CN /* 기타내용 */ , AA.LINK_PRCS_SE_CN AS LINK_PRCS_SE_CN /* 연계처리구분내용 */ , AA.RCPT_RQST_COURS_SE_CD AS RCPT_RQST_COURS_SE_CD /* 접수의뢰경로구분코드 */ , ( SELECT CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM FROM SAC100 x WHERE x.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'RCPT_RQST_COURS_SE_CD' AND x.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = AA.RCPT_RQST_COURS_SE_CD ) AS RCPT_RQST_COURS_SE_NM /* 접수의뢰경로구분명 */ , AA.LINK_INST_NM AS LINK_INST_NM /* 연계기관명 */ , AA.DEL_YN AS DEL_YN /* 삭제여부 */ FROM AYE100 AA WHERE 1=1 AND AA.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = #{BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO} AND AA.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '08'
mapper.update: /* * SQL-ID : isry.couns.constt.etcntabrd.mapper.BbsRplyListMapper : 댓글상담실(삭제) */ UPDATE AYE100 SET DEL_YN = 'Y' /* 삭제여부 */ , LAST_MDFCN_DT = SYSDATE /* 최종수정일 */ , LAST_MDFR_ID = #{LAST_MDFR_ID} /* 최종수정아이디 */ WHERE 1=1 AND BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = #{BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO} /* 게시글고유번호 */ AND BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = #{BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD} /* 게시글유형구분코드 */

CMNT_CN, /*댓글내용*/
WRTR_NM_ENCPT, /*작성자*/
CNTN_IP_ADDR, /*접속아이피*/
DEL_YN, /*삭제여부*/ FRST_RGTR_ID, /*최초등록아이디*/ FRST_REG_DT, /*최초등록일*/ LAST_MDFR_ID, /*최종수정아이디*/ LAST_MDFCN_DT /*최종수정일*/ ) VALUES( #{BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO} , '08' , AYE110_SQ01.NEXTVAL

mapper.select: SELECT /*SQL-ID : isry.couns.constt.etcntabrd.mapper.BbsRplyListMapper : 댓글상담실(댓글조회)*/ BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO /*게시글번호*/ ,BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD /*게시글구분코드*/ ,CMNT_ESNTAL_NO /*댓글고유번호*/ ,CMNT_CN /*댓글내용*/ ,C##RG.DEC_B64(WRTR_NM_ENCPT) AS WRTR_NM_ENCPT /*작성자*/ ,DEL_YN /*삭제여부*/ ,CNTN_IP_ADDR /*접속아이피주소*/ ,FRST_RGTR_ID /*최초등록아이디*/ ,TO_CHAR(FRST_REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS FRST_REG_YMD /*최초등록일자*/ ,TO_CHAR(FRST_REG_DT, 'AM HH24:MI:SS') AS FRST_REG_TIME /*최초등록일자*/ ,LAST_MDFR_ID /*최종수정아이디*/ ,LAST_MDFCN_DT /*최종수정일자*/ FROM AYE110 WHERE 1=1 AND BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '08' /*게시글유형구분코드*/ AND DEL_YN = 'N' /*삭제여부*/ AND BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = #{BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO} /*게시글번호*/ ORDER BY FRST_REG_DT DESC
